description: A sponsorship-funded resource and newsletter for working insurance underwriters.
tagline: The practical reference hub for commercial and specialty underwriters.

authors.name: Editorial Team
authors.bio: The editorial team at the Institute of Underwriting produces and curates resources for commercial and specialty insurance professionals.

editorial.how_we_test: We consult with practicing commercial and specialty underwriters to review materials for accuracy and practical relevance. We do not accredit or certify.
editorial.how_we_make_money: Our resources are free for readers and funded entirely by insurtech sponsorships. Sponsor content is clearly marked.
editorial.corrections: If we publish an error, we update the article and note the correction at the bottom of the page.
